en: No way! Wow, you sure do move a lot. I've lived in Saitama since I was born.
Oh, wow. At your parents' house, I take it?
Yeah. My parents are cool with me working at night, so I don't live alone. But most hostesses have to move out of their parents' place.
Saitama, huh?
Hey, hold on. Are you sighing because you're disappointed?
No, it's not that. It's just that you're not from Tokyo.
Well, no. But the girls here come from places like Chiba and Yokohama, too. We're from all over.
I suppose that's part of the charm of a Tokyo cabaret club.
Have you been working here long?
No, quite the opposite! Today's my first day!
Oh really? So you didn't even work any trial shifts?
Nope. But I did go through a lot of training.
You don't look it. I'd expect you to be a lot more nervous for your first time.
Maybe because I got so much training? It doesn't really feel like it's my first time.
So does that mean I'm your very first client?
Hehehe. I actually had another client right before you.
Aww, it was just some pointless small talk for a bit, and then suddenly time was up!
Good job. Some girls are so nervous their first time that they can barely hold a conversation.
Really? I must have a knack for it, then!
That's no good. If you don't try to get the customer to order more things, how are you going to make a profit?
Oh yeah, right. I didn't even think about that!
You'll pick it up with experience.
Would you like to order something, Kiryu-san?
Huh? Uh, sure.
That's a shame. I wish I'd gotten here earlier.
Well, you can still be the first client to request me by name!
You're a real silver-tongued devil, aren't you? At this rate, you'll have regular clients lined up in no time.
And wouldn't you like to be one of them, hmm?
Hey, now. You do realize it's not that easy to get regular clients, right?
Wow, talk about a wet blanket.
Well, it's true.
I'll consider it. I am going to be in town for a while.
Really? Then you have to come back!
You know, you don't want to look too desperate for customers, either.
I'm guessing you were an assistant?
Well, yes, but I still had to pay a lot of attention. It was tough.
If you're not careful, you'll never be able to get a customer on your own. Even if you're an assistant, you should make yourself desirable to guests.
Sounds like you have a lot of cabaret club experience, Kiryu-san. You could almost be a trainer, I bet.
I was more or less, a long time ago.
Oh hey, listen up!
My rank here in the club went up!
Well, look at you. You only just started, too. Do you already have that many regular clients?
Only a few, but still, they've come back a number of times.
Good. Guess I should step it up as well.
Keep at it. It's much harder to maintain your rank than to raise it. It's going to be tough.
I hear that. I'm going to give it my all!
So, what's your rank?
Honestly? I'm still just number twenty.
For a club this big, that's pretty good.
I guess. I really want to be top-tier soon.
I'm sure you will. You've got what it takes.
But how soon is soon? This is a big month for earning money, but I'm not making any progress at this rate.
Soon enough. I have faith in you.
All righty, then, Kiryu-san. Are you going to help get my rank up?
Sure. There's a certain thrill in helping a hostess you like move up in the ranks.
You're the best, Kiryu-san! So is it Gold Champagne time then?
Hold up! I can't afford that.
What? Ugh, in that case, don't make promises you can't keep.
If you're going to be cheap, you shouldn't have come here in the first place.
Hey, wait a second...
Maybe later. I'm kind of strapped for cash right now, but I'll be back for more as soon as I can.
You mean it? Next time for sure then!
Next time for sure.
Is there something else going on? You shouldn't be in such a rush, you know.
Don't change the subject! Are you gonna help me out or not?
Wait until your birthday. Then you can get your clients to go on dates with you as part of your birthday present.
But my birthday is on Valentine's Day. The club is having a special event for it, so I might not be able to make much money.
Ah, well. You'll just have to try harder than usual to make money.
Yeeeah. I'm not so sure.
So what? That only makes it better. You'll have double the reason to earn enough to raise your rank.
Right! Then you have to come see me in February, okay, Kiryu-san?
I wonder if I'll still be in Kamurocho then.
Don't try to rush things. You'll need help from your customers to make money, so you need to start by fostering relationships with them.
All righty then, Kiryu-san. Are you gonna help get my rank up there?
It's not that, exactly. But I heard that one new girl brought in three million yen in just three days.
That's incredible. I imagine it's hard enough to bring in three million over a whole month. Was she really a new hostess?
No way. She couldn't have been new, then. She had to be someone who had high-rollers as customers from another club.
I heard she was completely new. So I thought I'd try to see if I could hit the same target that she did.
I guess it's just not possible, though. I know it doesn't reflect badly on my own skills, but I'm still kind of disappointed.
That's par for the course. Just be yourself. Don't push yourself to do the impossible.
And things are looking up lately, aren't they? So even if it takes some time, I'm sure you'll be able to become the number one girl.
I sure hope so. I'm just super worried that my rank might drop back down or something.
Just work hard so that doesn't happen.
Don't give up. It may not be doable now, but someday you might be able to bring in three million in three days. Aim high.
Yeah, you're right! I'll keep at it, one day at a time, until that time comes!
You know, you really might have it in you.
I've thought this since I first met you, but you have a face that's really easy to remember, Kiryu-san. It's impossible to forget.
I bet you've never met anyone who didn't recognize you again later.
I guess you're right. Especially in this city, people will often call out to me when I'm walking around town.
That's so cool! When I walk through this part of town, people think I'm a tourist.
People will recognize you soon enough.
That's not true. When I'm here in town, the same punks always try to mess with me. If they recognized me, they'd know better by now.
Really? Yeah, I get ticked off because the same set of creeps keep bugging me. It's like, get with the program, you bozos.
Yeah, it happens.
I have the reverse problem. I run into people who recognize me all the time, but I can never put a name to their face.
Ahaha! So you've got a bad memory, Kiryu-san? I didn't expect that from you!
It comes with getting older. I've met hundreds, maybe thousands of people. It's hard to keep track of them all.
I'm really good at remembering clients' faces. Like, one look and I'll remember right away what we've talked about and stuff.
Impressive. I'm not sure I can even remember all the things I've talked about.
Oh, really? Then have you forgotten everything the two of us have talked about, Kiryu-san?
Yeah. When I go out drinking, I just want to have a good time. I don't really think back on it after the fact.
Really? It seems kind of pointless for me to be the only one who remembers. Maybe I should forget about you too, Kiryu-san.
It depends. You can't expect me to remember everything, after all.
I'm fine when it comes to work. I remember everything I need.
As a taxi driver, I have regular passengers who I recognize on sight. I don't even need to ask where they're going.
Some passengers have specific routes they want me to take. I have to remember a lot of details, so as not to upset them.
I see! I'm not that good yet, but I'll try to make sure I can remember more!
Do your best.
That's to be expected. It would be rude of you to not remember your own clients.
So you do remember, Kiryu-san?
But you just said yourself that you have a really bad memory!
Of course. I have a lot of fun talking to you. It leaves a strong impression.
No. When I go out drinking, I just want to have a good time. I don't really think back on it after the fact.
Hey, that's way worse than me! I have a lot of customers to keep track of, and it's not easy.
It's not possible for me. But it should be a necessary job skill for a hostess.
You should be taking notes on what you talked about right after a client leaves, so you don't forget.
What? Everyone does that?
Men appreciate it when a hostess sends an email that includes details from their conversations. It makes them feel good that you remember them.
Wow, really? And here I thought I was going above and beyond just remembering anything at all, but I guess I was wrong!
That's how you get ahead of the game.
Okay, so when's my birthday?
January 4th, right?
January 14th, right?
January 24th, right?
February 4th, right?
It's February 14th, right?
February 24th, right?
December 4th, right?
December 14th, right?
December 24th, right?
Wow, you really do remember! That makes me feel kinda warm and fuzzy.
See, I told you.
Huh? Wait, I never told you when my birthday was, Kiryu-san.
Uh, you didn't?
So wait, how did you know? Honestly, now I'm a little creeped out.
Maybe it was just a lucky guess.
Nope! See, you did forget! I'm so disappointed in you.
Oops.
Hold on. You've never told me when your birthday is.
Huh? I haven't?
Then why didn't you say so earlier? Of course you wouldn't have known it, silly!
Heh. You're a real piece of work, you know that?
Hey, so there's something I've been wondering about for a while.
You know how they write "LAST" on the price board outside? Do you have any idea why they write it like that?
I do. I've been coming to cabaret clubs for years now, after all.
No, why? I don't stay out drinking until closing time much anymore, so I've never noticed.
They do that?
Uh, yeah! I would have expected you to be more perceptive than that.
I used to think that the closing time would change based on how good business was doing  that day.
But as it turns out, we can only be open until one o'clock.
Well, if you say that you're usually open until one o'clock, customers might assume you're not open any later, and then they won't come.
Right, 'cause the club is actually open past that, but on the down-low! I was kind of surprised, because cabaret clubs had this wholesome image.
You're right. That's why for the last few years cabaret clubs have been open during the day, since they can't be open all night.
Oh, I see. That makes sense.
You didn't know that? That's why the cops will swing by every once in a while.
Yeah, I know! It was so sudden that it gave me quite a shock.
Oh? The police came here?
Yeah, something happened.
This cop showed up, telling us that we were open longer than we were supposed to be, and forced us to close right on the spot.
Did anything happen to you?
I was fine. But the last train home had already left, so I was going to crash at a net café. But then I got a call from the manager.
She was like, "We're reopening, so get back here right away."
You're manager made a bold move. You'd figure after catching heat, you'd want to lay low for a while.
Oh, yeah. She really is a go-getter. She usually doesn't seem all that tough, but in this case she was pretty badass.
Unbelievable. If you'd been caught again, they would have shut this place down for good.
Right! And then we'd all be out of work. She should have considered our well-being a bit more.
So, what did you do? Did you go back?
I did, but a lot of the other girls had already taken cabs home.
I guess they never expected they'd be asked to come back, huh?
But there were actually customers who came at that hour, and one of them really liked me a lot!
But we were understaffed because the other girls didn't come back. I had to go take care of other customers, and he got all mad and left.
That's bad luck. He may have wound up becoming a good repeat customer.
I know! And I worked super hard too! This is all the manager's fault!
Did you complain to her about it?
Yeah, so she's taking me out for yakiniku⑬the expensive kind! I'm going to eat a ton!
You've got nerve, I'll give you that.
Don't worry about it. If you work here long enough, that's bound to happen a few times.
